records.observation: Primitive subclass. Primitive-seeded constructor stores category-to-object lists and, for states, start-time TreeSet plus child-shadow list. Copy constructor copies category weights from source map, not object lists. Both merge methods check vertex array length only, average each vertex time by real-object counts, expand inherited time bounds and increment count; line ID/topology compatibility otherwise relies on caller. Shadow merge rescales existing ratios by old/new duration and incoming ratios by incoming/new duration, copies missing weights and adds counts/ratios for existing categories. No zero-duration/count-overflow guard. initializeMapOfCategoryWeights sums each drawable duration/shadow duration as float per category and stores count. State finalization initializes each exclusion against child shadows, uses covering-parent stack to subtract child exclusion, adds category exclusive ratios, then clears/nulls nesting and object collections; lifecycle-dependent methods are not generally reusable. summarize scales weights by shadow/buffer duration and updates category summaries. Byte size Primitive+28+20 per category (array/map/object-map precedence). Serialization writes Primitive, explicit bounding box, long count, int weight count and weights sorted by INCL_RATIO_ORDER; reading nonpositive count sets array null, does not reconstruct output maps. resolveCategory iterates array backwards with short circuit: after false, remaining category resolution calls are skipped. toString output-map branch casts untyped Collection.toArray Object[] to CategoryWeight[] (cast-failure path), whereas input array branch avoids it. Search assumes nonnull weight array. State preview uses bounds and nesting height; arrow uses bounds with mapped endpoint rows and count-based stroke, event combines bounds with averaged start time. State hit test stores selected subcategory. Default insets (0,2,0,2); arrow base10 with ten widths1..10, repeated integer division capped at width10; setter lacks zero-base guard. Delegated Primitive, CategoryWeight/CategoryRatios and preview internals require separate reading. Local path observations do not establish normal-call failures; archived code not executed.
